cards.text: The Pharisees and scribes are grumbling that Jesus welcomes sinners and eats with them (Luke 15:1-2). He's already told them about a lost sheep and a lost coin (Luke 15:3-10). Now Jesus says, 'There was a man who had two sons.'

cards.question: The younger of the two sons goes to his father with a request. What does he ask for?

answers.text: A field of his own to farm

cards.question: The father refuses the younger son's request.

cards.text: The father divides his property between both sons, and a few days later the younger one gets everything together and journeys to a distant country. A FEW DAYS! I've had cookies sit on the cooling rack longer than that.

cards.question: Out in that distant country, the younger son ___ his wealth in wild living.

cards.text: He spends all he has, and THEN a severe famine sweeps through that country. That's your paycheck running out the same day your car breaks down.

cards.question: In need, the younger son hires himself out to a citizen of that country. Where does the man send him?

answers.text: Into his fields to feed the pigs
Into his vineyard to pick grapes
Into his house to serve meals

cards.text: He's so hungry he longs to fill his belly with the pods the pigs are eating. When you're eyeing the pigs' pods, friend, you have hit ROCK bottom.

cards.question: Hungry out in the fields, the younger son gets food from people who take pity on him.
When the younger son finally comes to his senses, he remembers there's plenty of food back at his ___'s place while he's starving.

cards.text: So he makes a plan. He'll get up, go back to his father and say, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.'

cards.question: In the speech he's planning, what does the younger son want to ask his father to make him?

answers.text: Like one of his hired servants
Heir of all his father's land

cards.text: So he gets up and heads home with that speech ready, like somebody walking into the boss's office with an apology memorized. But while he's still in the distance, his father sees him.

cards.question: The father spots his younger son while he's still far off. What does the father do?

answers.text: Runs to him and embraces him
Waits for him at the front door
Sends a servant out to meet him

cards.question: When the father sees his younger son coming home in the distance, he is filled with ___.

cards.text: The son gives his speech: he has sinned against heaven and against his father, and he's no longer worthy to be called his son. But the hired servant part? Not in it this time.
But the father tells his servants, 'Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him.' A ring on his finger, sandals on his feet.
Then the father says, 'Bring the fattened calf and kill it.' That's walking into the boss's office with an apology and walking out with a PROMOTION.

cards.question: Why does the father say it's time to celebrate his younger son?

answers.text: His son was dead and is alive again
His son has paid back all the money
His son has promised to work harder

cards.text: Meanwhile the older son is out in the field, and as he gets near the house, he hears music and dancing. That's clocking out after a long shift and finding a party you didn't get the group text for.

cards.question: Hearing the music and dancing, the older son heads straight inside to see what's going on.

cards.text: He calls one of the servants, who says his brother has returned, and the father has killed the fattened calf because he has him back safe and sound.

cards.question: Hearing that his brother is home, the older son refuses to go in.
The older son is angry and stays outside. So his father comes out and ___ with him.

cards.text: The older son lets it out: all these years he's served his father and never disobeyed a commandment, yet he never got even a young goat to celebrate with his friends. This man has been keeping a list for YEARS.
Then he says, '…when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him!'

cards.question: Complaining to his father, the older son calls the younger one my brother.
The older son complains he never got even a young goat. What does the father tell him?

answers.text: Everything the father has is his
A feast for him is coming soon
He can have the next fattened calf

cards.text: 'Son, you are always with me,' the father says. That's me griping nobody ever saved me ONE cookie while I'm standing in my own bakery holding the keys!

cards.question: The father tells the older son it was fitting to celebrate, because this ___ of yours was dead and is alive again.

cards.text: The father finishes, 'he was lost and is found.' Jesus ends it right there, friend, and He never says whether the older son goes in to the party.
